title: Spectre: Continuous Refinement and Closed-Loop Verification for Rust — VMCAI 2027 Artifact
description:
Artifact for the VMCAI 2027 paper 'Spectre: Continuous Refinement and Closed-Loop Verification for Rust'. Includes the Spectre tool binary (Go), Rust miner (spectre-mine-rs), all benchmark specifications, and a reproduction script (artifact/reproduce.sh) covering all four research questions:

- RQ1: Raft election-safety verification with BFS, ample-set-style POR heuristic, warm-cache re-run, and incremental re-verification (Tables 2–3)
- RQ2: SMT-backed semantic-sync ablation on bank_account mutations (Table 5)
- RQ3: CEGIS/WP closed-loop repair across five defect classes (Tables 4, 6)
- RQ4: Spec mining from nine Rust components; property-directed vs random exploration (Tables 7–8)

Docker image available on request; see Dockerfile at repository root. Build requirements: Go ≥ 1.24, Rust stable, Z3 (for SMT sync).
notes: Reproduction script: sh artifact/reproduce.sh (short run: SKIP_LONG=1 sh artifact/reproduce.sh). Docker: docker build -t spectre-vmcai . && docker run --rm spectre-vmcai sh /artifact/reproduce.sh
